title: Character Schedule Project Schema
description: Schedule project with a typed variable space, independent expression macros, built-in variable assignment, and sequence/branch task macros. References, write permissions, scopes, types and cell counts also require application validation.

icon.description: Local activity icon key, for example tabler:calendar. Empty uses the default icon.

engine_key.description: Optional engine contract name. Duplicate nonempty keys warn in the editor but do not invalidate the project.

tags.description: Editor-only labels. No leading or trailing whitespace. Not exported to runtime.
